Hi Andreia, it's Brian. You asked me for some tips before your first call with the Boston team, so here they are. First, be punctual. In the United States, a call at nine means nine, not nine ten. Second, keep the small talk short. Two minutes is fine, and then people want to get to the point. That is not rude, it is just a different style. Third, Americans are quite straightforward, but they are rarely blunt. They say things like I wanted to check or I was hoping we could, and that soft tone is important. Finally, your Latin American colleagues usually need more time to build rapport. So, as the person in the middle, give a little space to both styles. You will be great.
